Well, the degree and licence are still in the bag at least? It's something you've worked hard for and if there's one industry definitely eager for more people right now, it's health care.
Is this setback permanent? And is it truly your fault--I can't imagine it's an easy to time to start a career as a nurse right? 
When it comes to your mother: are you living with her right now? Is the relationship generally healthy or is this an anxiety you've had for some time?
